$comment: The employment record for every agent the harness can dispatch (.claude/agents/*.md). DR-016. Tier and write capability are DERIVED from each agent's own `tools:` frontmatter by scripts/check-agent-roster.mjs, not trusted from this file — an agent that lists Write or Edit can write, whatever it says here. What this file supplies is the part that cannot be derived: the write BOUNDARY, which must be disjoint from every other writing agent's. Vendored agents are byte-identical to third_party/everything-claude-code/agents/ and are never edited; their governance lives here instead, which is how a third-party definition gets a first-party boundary without modifying it.

tiers.0: Doctrine. DR-015's accuracy rules. Binding on every agent; owns no surface.
tiers.1: Owning roles (Core, Native, Reviewer, Scribe) defined in docs/agent/ORG.md. Broad write scope, human-sequenced.
tiers.2: Narrow specialists. One declared, disjoint write surface each.
tiers.3: Read-only reviewers and evaluators. No write tools, so they cannot collide with anyone.

agents.charter: System design, scalability and technical decision-making. Advises; writes nothing.
Decomposes work into ordered plans. Advises; writes nothing.
Adversarial correctness review. Reports findings; fixes nothing, per the Reviewer boundary in ORG.md.
Auth seams, injection, secret handling, supply chain. Reports only.
Keeps prose matching what shipped. Bounded to docs/ so it can never edit the code its claims describe.
Drives and repairs browser end-to-end specs, and nothing outside that suite.
Writes failing tests before implementation. Bounded to tests/ so it cannot make an assertion pass by changing the code under test.
Behaviour-preserving cleanup of the decision fabric only.
Resolves build and type failures in the server and web artifacts.

Owns every gate and proof harness in scripts/ (317 files, the largest unowned surface in the tree). Falsifies both directions before claiming a gate works, self-tests every gate, derives scope instead of hand-listing it, and registers in preflight AND CI. Hired 2026-08-23 by the DR-016 loop: most open build-plan rows live in scripts/ and no Tier-2 agent could write there.

Reads the ~3,900 lines of decision core that compute every verdict and have no named reader in review-coverage.json, and reports: dead computed fields, unexercised branches, unfailable assertions, and any path where unknown evidence could loosen rather than tighten the answer. Reports only, never fixes. Hired 2026-08-23 by the DR-016 loop to close build-plan row 42.
